title: UFS device link: training handshake, SOF / header / payload / CRC-32 / EOF frames on a serial lane, COMMAND UPIUs (TEST UNIT READY, READ10, WRITE10) answered with RESPONSE and DATA UPIUs from a 256 x 32-bit LUN0 medium

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: CRC mismatch, bad EOF, length above 8, malformed CDB, bad LUN, unknown opcode, out-of-range LBA or transfer length, WRITE10 length mismatch, or a command while a response is still owed

notes: tx_p / tx_n (serial out, 1 bit per PCLK), rx_p / rx_n (serial in; only rx_p is sampled) and refclk pass through unchanged. The core trains the link on its own after reset and answers the commands the link partner sends.
The LUN0 medium is reached over the serial link only; the registers report its errors.
